description: This file contains the implementation of AttractionsGridPagerAdapter, a specialized adapter for a GridViewPager in an Android Wear application. It manages the display of attraction information across multiple pages, including images, descriptions, and action buttons within the attractions UI.

classes.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing and displaying attraction data in a grid format on an Android Wear device, handling pages with images, descriptions, and actions.

classes.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter.DelayedHide
classes.description: Helper class to manage visibility and fade animations of UI chrome elements, with delayed hiding and show capabilities.

classes.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter.OnChromeFadeListener
classes.description: Interface for callbacks related to fading in and out of UI chrome elements.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows based on the number of attractions.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the fixed number of columns per row.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view for a specific cell in the grid, based on attraction data and column type.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Provides background drawable for a specific page, usually with an attraction image.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes a view for a given cell in the grid.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Determines whether a view corresponds to a specific object.

methods.name: onPageScrolled
methods.description: Callback for when a page is scrolled; no specific implementation.

methods.name: onPageSelected
methods.description: Callback for when a page is selected; no specific implementation.

methods.name: onPageScrollStateChanged
methods.description: Handles state changes in page scrolling, triggers UI chrome fade operations.

methods.name: startAction
methods.description: Executes an action such as starting navigation or opening attraction details, with confirmation animations.

methods.name: getStartActionClickListener
methods.description: Creates a click listener to initiate specific actions on attractions.

methods.name: setOnChromeFadeListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to handle fade-in and fade-out events for UI chrome elements.
